contact.department: Fulton County GIS (Department of Information Technology)

counties.notes: Repointed 2026-10-18 to Fulton County GIS's own ArcGIS Online copy of the tax parcels (item e581a072dca9442e884d3682bff03484, owner Fulton_County_GIS, public, last edited 2026-09-22): Tax_Parcels/FeatureServer/0 on services1.arcgis.com, 373,306 polygon tax parcels covering Atlanta and the rest of Fulton County, TaxYear 2026, the same schema as the former PropertyMapViewer layer 11, maxRecordCount 1,000, pagination on, CORS open (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *). Use the unsuffixed Tax_Parcels service, not the Tax_Parcels_2025 or Tax_Parcels_2024 snapshots beside it. It replaces the county's on-premises server gismaps.fultoncountyga.gov, which stopped accepting connections on ports 443 and 80 on 2026-10-18 (autoheal #1082). Verified 2026-10-18: UPPER(Owner) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns real owners with full Atlanta-area site addresses (e.g., '123 EXAMPLE TRC', '456 SOUTH EXAMPLE ST'). Owner names use last-name-first concatenated format (e.g., 'LAST FIRST M LAST FIRST M' for joint ownership). Both site address and owner mailing address are exposed. On 42 rows the owner is the county's RESTRICTED marker rather than a name, and the atlas withholds those rows.

Cobb County (Marietta seat, pop. 766,000; Atlanta metro northwest) maintains a Tax Assessor parcel layer at gis.cobbcounty.org that refreshes nightly from CAMA data -- the service name 'taxassessorsdaily' reflects this cadence. 36+ confirmed fields: PIN, PARID, PARCEL_TYPE, OWNER_NAM1/2 (owner names), SITUS_ADDR (site address), OWNER_ADDR/CITY/STAT/ZIP (owner mailing address), TAXDIST, ACRES, FMV_LAND (fair-market land value), FMV_BLDG, FMV_TOTAL, ASV_LAND (assessed land), ASV_BLDG, ASV_TOTAL, CLASS (property class), NBHOOD_NUM (neighborhood code). Verified 2026-05-15: SMITH returns results from Acworth, Marietta, Powder Springs, and Kennesaw. Cobb County borders Atlanta only in limited segments and has no parcel-boundary overlap with the city. The county's GIS Hub at geo-cobbcountyga.hub.arcgis.com and the Property Search portal at gis.cobbcounty.org/PropertySearch.html both provide web-interface access. The Cobb County Board of Tax Assessors (cobbassessor.org) is the authoritative record for appeals, exemptions, and recent reassessment values.

DeKalb County (pop. 764,000; Atlanta metro east and north core) should not be confused with DeKalb County IL (FIPS 17037) or DeKalb County IN in the atlas. The GA DeKalb parcel REST layer at dcgis.dekalbcountyga.gov/hosted/rest/services/Parcels/MapServer exposes 20+ confirmed fields. PARCELID is an 11-digit identifier with spaces (e.g., '06 249 03 007') reflecting district, map sheet, block, and parcel components. Owner fields: OWNERNME1/2. Site address: SITEADDRESS. The CVTTXCD and CVTTXDSCRP fields identify the city/tax district, which matters because several cities -- Decatur, Brookhaven, Dunwoody, Tucker, Doraville, Stone Mountain -- maintain separate municipal boundaries within the county. SCHLTXCD and SCHLDSCRP identify the school tax district. Classification: USECD, USEDSCRP, CLASSCD, CLASSDSCRP, and PRPRTYDSCRP. Verified 2026-05-15: SMITH returns Doraville and Atlanta-DeKalb addresses. For full assessment and exemption records, the DeKalb County Tax Commissioner portal at tax.dekalbcountyga.gov is the authoritative lookup.

Gwinnett County, Georgia (Lawrenceville; FIPS 13135) is not served by this atlas as of 2026-11-10. The county's open-data portal attaches this license text to its parcel data: 'So as not to conflict or interfere with the data sales of Gwinnett County government, the copyrighted data shall be used for internal purposes by recipient only and may not be distributed or sold in any way to any person or entity.' UrbanKit does not serve it without the county's permission. Until 2026-11-10 this record listed layer 3 (the Tax Master Table) of the county's Property_and_Tax FeatureServer under the license 'public', which was wrong; on 2026-11-10 that service no longer has a layer 3. The county's owner service, FYT_Owner_Data, is public but unlisted and carries no license text of its own. Owner and mailing records are available through the Gwinnett County Tax Assessors' property search.

coverage.summary: Gwinnett County's data license limits its GIS data to internal use by the recipient, not for distribution or sale, so we don't serve it without the county's permission. Use the county's Tax Assessors property search, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.

counties.notes: Savannah and Chatham County, published by SAGIS. 125,326 parcels with owner names on 124,952 rows (99.7 percent), and the fullest field set in this batch: parcel id, two owner columns, a complete mailing address, a combined situs and split situs parts. Important for maintenance: this service holds 28 year-versioned layers, 0 to 17 being Historic Parcels 1998 to 2015 and 18 to 27 being Parcel Digest 2016 to 2025. Layer 27 is the newest today. When SAGIS publishes Parcel Digest 2026 it will be layer 28 and this entry will silently go a year stale, so the layer index needs checking whenever this record is reverified.

Dougherty County, Georgia (county seat Albany) publishes its parcels as the 'Dougherty County Land Parcels Dataset' FeatureServer, maintained by Albany GIS, covering both the CITY and COUNTY jurisdictions (the Jurisdiction column says which). 38,007 parcels as of 2026-10-03. The owner is in Name, the parcel id in ParcelNum, the site address in Address (with SiteCity and SiteZip) and the owner mailing address in MailAddress1/MailCity/MailState/MailZip; MailAddress1 was empty on the first rows sampled. String fields are space padded to their full width, so trim them and search with UPPER(Name) LIKE 'SMITH%', never equality. The layer's spatial reference is wkid 102667 (latestWkid 2240), so send outSR=4326 if you need longitude and latitude. CORS answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin *. No open-data license is stated; the item carries only a disclaimer that Albany GIS makes every effort at accuracy and that all data is subject to change. A third-party count of 39,443 parcels is slightly higher than the layer's, so the public view may be a subset. Verified live 2026-10-03: owner SMITH returned rows (first row 0000S/00003/03A, Albany).

Forsyth County, Georgia (FIPS 13117). The county's public parcel layer (geo.forsythco.com, Public/Tax_Parcel layer 0, 105,607 parcels) carries a parcel id, site address and postal address, but no owner name field. For owner records, contact the Forsyth County Board of Assessors.

coverage.summary: Forsyth County's public parcel layer has parcel ids and site and postal addresses but no owner names, so we don't index it. Check with the county Board of Assessors, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.

counties.notes: Effingham County, Georgia (county seat Springfield; FIPS 13103). Served by the county GIS's ArcGIS Online feature service Parcels2024 (account Effingham_GIS, item 418183e9b970425f8dfce879e47e3878, flagged public_authoritative, item modified 2026-11-05), the parcel layer behind the county's Interactive GIS Map. Read 2026-11-10: 34,313 parcels; LASTNAME (the owner, despite the column name) is non-blank on 34,075; UPPER(LASTNAME) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns 476, the sample query's predicate. The owner mailing address is spread over address1, address2 and address3 (one of them may hold a street, a c/o line or a P O Box, and the others are a single space) plus CityStateZ, which is space padded ('GUYTON               GA 31312'); site address is StreetAdd, also padded ('123 EXAMPLE   RD'). Capabilities Query only, maxRecordCount 1000 with pagination, WKID 102100, CORS open (Access-Control-Allow-Origin *). Exemption column, not listed: HOMEEXEMPT holds homestead and senior exemption codes. Not used: Effingham_County_Parcels on services8.arcgis.com, which holds only a few hundred county-owned parcels. Terms: no license text on the item or the layer (licenseInfo empty, copyright empty), and the county's Interactive GIS Map page carries no data-use text.

dataVintage.body: The layer is named Parcels2024, but its sale dates and edit date are current: on 2026-11-10 the newest sale date was 2026-11-04, 3,010 parcels carry a sale dated in 2026, and the layer was last edited on 2026-11-05. Two rows carry a sale date in 2027, which looks like a data-entry error in the county's file.

source.label: Effingham County Parcels2024 (county ArcGIS Online item)

counties.notes: Spalding County, Georgia (Griffin; FIPS 13255). The only public parcel layer found, Parcels_Public_View on the ArcGIS Online organisation maintained by the City of Griffin GIS team and published by the Spalding County Water Authority, has 33,712 parcel polygons with a parcel id and a jurisdiction field only, with no owner name, mailing address or site address, as of 2026-11-10; the same organisation's other layers carry no owner either. Owner names are shown one parcel at a time on the Spalding County Tax Assessor's property site (a Schneider qPublic portal), which has no public query service. For parcel and owner records, use that site or contact the Spalding County Tax Assessor's Office.

coverage.summary: Spalding County's public parcel layer has parcel ids but no owner names or mailing addresses, so we don't index it. The Tax Assessor's property search shows owners one parcel at a time. Request it and we'll tell you if that changes.

counties.notes: Dooly County, Georgia (county seat Vienna; FIPS 13093). Served by the county's own ArcGIS Online organisation (the one that also publishes the county's 911 addresses, voting districts and zoning layers): feature service Parcel_Regions_w_WinGAP, item 1f883189ff944f74b71e8748c39a2d0d, public, the standard WinGAP parcel export that joins the tax roll to the parcel polygons. Read 2026-11-15: 7,344 parcels, layer last edited 2026-11-05; lastname (the whole owner string, despite the column name) is non-blank on 7,324; firstname and middle are blank on all but a handful of rows and are not listed; UPPER(lastname) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns 143, the sample query's predicate. SITUS is split across columns with no combined situs column: house_no (an integer, 0 where the parcel has no number) and street_nam, with the directional in stdirect, the suffix in sttype and a house-number suffix and unit in extension and unit; the house number and street name are listed as the composite pair (as Hennepin MN's HOUSE_NO and STREET_NM are), and stdirect is declared the pair's directional (role situs-directional, atlas 0.9.7): 686 parcels carry one (E 254, N 196, W 134, S 101, and one Q, which is not a direction and is ignored), and the site address reads house_no, stdirect, street_nam. The owner mailing address is spread over address1, address2 and address3 plus city, state and zip_code: address2 holds the street or P O Box on most rows (6,023), address1 holds a c/o or second-name line, or the street when address2 is blank (2,373 rows non-blank), so read all three. The record's mailing column is address2, and address1 is its declared fallback (role mailing-fallback, atlas 0.9.7), read only when address2 is blank: on the 1,255 rows whose street or P O Box sits in address1 alone (address2 blank), address1 is read only when it is a mailing line (a whole house number then a word, a P O Box or Drawer with its number, or a rural route box, with no owner-entity, share, c/o, attention or withheld word such as LLC, COMPANY, TRUSTEE, HEIRS, ET AL, INT, C/O, CARE OF, ATTN, ATTENTION, CONFIDENTIAL or 1 OF 2, however it is spelled, where an entity word directly before a street suffix is part of the street name when nothing but a unit and its number follows the suffix): 1,053 start with a digit and 194 are P O Boxes, and on 2026-11-15 1,247 of them are read, while 8 stay blank (the 2 c/o lines and 6 other values). A redaction marker in address1 or in stdirect withholds the row whatever address2 holds; none does on 2026-11-15. Parcel ID: Parcel_No is a fixed-width string padded with spaces, the map, block and parcel in fixed columns (' 23     25' is map 23 parcel 25; 'U 5   1  1' is map U5 block 1 parcel 1). The id typed with single spaces ('23 25') matches nothing, and a LIKE with % between the parts can match more than one parcel (Parcel_No LIKE 'U 5%1%1' matched 2 on 2026-11-15), so query the parts exactly (Map = 'U5' AND Block = '1' AND Parcel = '1', with SubParcel for a lettered split) or match the full padded value. Realkey is the integer CAMA key, and qPub_Link deep-links each row's report on the county's qPublic site. String columns are padded, so trim the values. Capabilities Query only, maxRecordCount 2000 with pagination, WKID 102100, CORS open (Access-Control-Allow-Origin *). No row carries the no_release withhold flag. Exemption column, not listed: homeexempt holds the homestead exemption codes. Not used: the regional commission's Dooly_County_Parcels layer, whose data is from 2022. Terms: the ArcGIS Online item carries no license, access or description text, and the county's Terms of Use (doolycountyga.gov/terms) say only that public records and government works are available for reuse consistent with Georgia law; no limit on sale or commercial use was found.

counties.notes: Gordon County, Georgia (county seat Calhoun; FIPS 13129). The only public parcel layer found, GC Parcels (layer 3 of the OpenGov feature service on the county's ArcGIS Online organisation, published for the county's OpenGov permitting system), has 28,878 parcel polygons with a parcel id (PIN), acreage, a property class and a city code, and no owner name, site address or mailing address, as of 2026-11-21; the same service's address points carry addresses and parcel numbers but no owners. The county's GIS page links only to the Tax Assessor's property site (a Schneider qPublic/Beacon portal), which shows owners one parcel at a time and has no public query service. The county sells GIS layers as shapefiles under a signed disclaimer (GIS Fee Schedule, 2008). For parcel and owner records, use the qPublic site or contact the Gordon County GIS Office.

coverage.summary: Gordon County's public parcel layer has parcel ids but no owner names or addresses, so we don't index it. The Tax Assessor's property search shows owners one parcel at a time. Request it and we'll tell you if that changes.
